headlines.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Stock Looks Overvalued On Its 5x Three Year Run
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings has been one of the headline cyber security stocks in recent years. Its sharp share price gains now put a spotlight on a more old fashioned question for investors: how much book value actually supports that market valuation. Over the past 3 years the stock has delivered a very large total return of roughly 5x, which puts a lot of weight on whether the balance sheet and accounting equity base can support such a move.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike 2026 Legal Threat Landscape Report: Cybercriminals Blur Digital and Physical Lines in Attacks on U.S. Law Firms
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas, October 28, 2026--CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today released the CrowdStrike 2026 Legal Threat Landscape Report, revealing that financially motivated adversaries accounted for 82% of observed malicious activity against the legal sector, with CHATTY SPIDER emerging as a dominant threat to U.S. law firms. Cybercriminals are finding new ways to monetize the sector, escalating from social engineering to physical intrusions to steal and turn sensitive client information into profit.

headlines.title: Black October Is Changing How Companies Buy Cybersecurity. 5 Stocks in the Line of Fire
headlines.summary: A surge of AI-discovered vulnerabilities have shaken companies to their core, and five cybersecurity stocks moved hard on a single day. But with some already up over 150% this year, investors now face a sharper question than whether the threat is real.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. Additionally, it has a partnership with Fortanix Inc. to combine its Falcon platform with Fortanix Confidential AI to provide an integrated solution for end-to-end AI security. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
